newsitem.title: USA: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. corn weekly export sales highlights - USDA.

text.p: USDA corn export sales highlights in latest reporting week:
Net sales of 1,261,800 MT--a marketing-year high--were two-fifths above the week earlier and nearly double the 4-week average.
Major increases were recorded for Taiwan (372,200 MT), Japan (260,000 MT), unknown destinations (125,500 MT), Spain (102,800 MT), South Korea (99,600 MT), and Mexico (72,000 MT).

Exports of 1,335,700 MT were 55 percent above the prior week and two-fifths over the 4-week average. The primary recipients were Japan (513,500 MT), Taiwan (214,200 MT), South Korea (153,700 MT), Malaysia (87,800 MT), Chile (86,500 MT), and Venezuela (50,600 MT).
